gate.negative_control: Retaining the catalog writer through the identity pause fails the second-worker progress assertion; the restored implementation passes.
gate.durability: Reserve rows in a FULL transaction before assigning the inode xattr; sync the inode before publication. Only reservation holds the catalog permit; native identity I/O and read-only candidate setup can overlap across inodes.
gate.concurrency: Two workers; same-inode packing exclusion and epoch validation remain. A paused identity phase permits the other worker to complete durable publication and retirement.

limitations: Two reversed-order rounds on a shared node, not a statistical significance claim.
Warm OS caches; debug incremental only.
CPU idle observation does not prove background sealing drained.
Cumulative phase times overlap; they are not added Cargo latency.
Two workers in both SL7 cases; fixed source/profile/output paths; the candidate releases the catalog permit before native identity I/O.
